description: Next.js app calling its own API, a weather provider and a CMS over hardcoded http:// URLs, and a newsletter form posting to an http:// endpoint — VC032 must fire on each. testimonials.tsx guards the old substring path skip ("test" in the filename); site-footer.tsx guards the old whole-file skip for any component with an inline <svg xmlns>. station-specs.tsx guards the review fix: a product file named -specs is product code, not a spec/test file, and is still scanned.
